battleship.py.name: Shared-terminal game loop
battleship.py.description: Creates two players, asks for fleet placement and handoff, alternates game_turn calls and starts Game at module top level. Importing it would start interactive play.

players.py.name: Player state
players.py.description: Prompts for captain name, constructs a Board, and starts an empty attempted_shots list.

boards.py.name: Grid, placement and combat
boards.py.description: Builds a ten-by-ten grid and five ships; prompts for orientation and coordinates, checks placement, records shots, updates hit/miss markers and exits on victory. Coordinate checks contain questionable bounds logic; this map is not gameplay verification.

ships.py.name: Ship damage model
ships.py.description: Stores name, length, coordinates, orientation and hit points. damage subtracts one and sunk reports depleted hit points.
